result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per twelve months, thirty days’ written notice, normal business hours, an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, Vendor-paid costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct or remote systems access. It preserves the audit’s usage-verification purpose. However, the added requirement that audits be conducted off-site wherever practicable goes beyond the stated playbook and is somewhat indeterminate, while the systems-access prohibition partly duplicates Section 22.2. The drafting is otherwise professional and coherent.
